confirmed_flow.fact: Film binds position to draft.centered, starts3, First assigns1 and Last assigns6 in every adaptive layout; native actions and bernControl activate callbacks use same assignment, not an independent scroll-event revision.
Keyed targets get bernScrollItem(swatch.id), snap center and anchor.center; modifier ordering supplies scope and horizontal axis.
14 uses native scrollPosition;13 ScrollViewReader uses initial-corrected anchor when eligible, otherwise the declared anchor; user scroll clears target and retires initial owner.
Initial owner retires on userScroll, disappearance, stops and every scroll(to:); finish clears waiting/key/applied and increments generation. Explicit First/Last do not keep the initial owner alive.

Correction requires ownership of initial key, center anchor, valid measured frame and positive finite margin domain. It applies only while initial owner is waiting; retired explicit targets use declared center.
Queued legacy snap records/checks generation and snapAllowed, so a later finish invalidates a not-yet-started work item. This does not prove behavior of an animation that already began.

minimal_conditional_sequence.purpose: Separates an explicit repeated same-ID request from the already-covered changed-value Last6/First1 path; does not assume resize causes misalignment.
required_evidence: Exact source/binary/window/normal and delivered action success plus model centered before/after each step
Actual viewport/native clip and chosen item center before resize, after settle and after repeated First; preserve actual scale/ICC/raw windows
To call a13 compatibility gap, the same applicable state/sequence must show13 fails to restore intended alignment while14 restores; existing outer geometry differences alone are insufficient
Internal owner lifetime/target/generation is not exposed by normal registry state; do not infer it from a final screenshot or demand a new probe without root authorization
minimal_conditional_sequence.sequence: Existing Film: initial3 → First1 → allow existing settle → resize using the existing window route → only if actual centered/nearest still1, activate First again.
minimal_conditional_sequence.stop_if: If position/nearest changed during resize or item remains correctly aligned, this sequence supplies no failure; do not force an offset or alter padding/anchor/constants.

not_inferred: No old immediate/wait/direct discrepancy attributed to owner, anchor, padding or font
No claim every pending/in-flight AppKit animation is cancelled; source guard covers queued work only
No failure of13 First/Last or wide window proven by source
not_performed: No source-executing model test, skills or subagent spawn
No new constant/ROI or Row/color/toolbar work
scope: Fixed e48 ScrollPosition/initial owner and Gallery Film First/Last/resize event path only. No old geometry archive reanalysis.

strict_static_findings.fact: The only scroll(to:) caller requires wanted!=target, with no await/target mutation before the callee tests target==wanted. Its same-target clear/reissue branch is unreachable through this caller. Both13 and14 share this code.
strict_static_findings.visible_effect_not_proven: A repeated First/Last assignment to an unchanged Equatable position does not provide a distinct onChange request. No visible failure follows if that item is already aligned; source alone does not establish that a resize left it misaligned.

strict_static_findings.fact: An owner is single-use per BernScrollItems StateObject: finish is permanent and begin cannot restart. Reappear on the same object cannot reacquire; a newly created object can.
strict_static_findings.unknown: Whether actual Gallery Film leave/return keeps that StateObject is not established by these files. The single-use comment is deliberate; no retained identity was observed.

strict_static_findings.fact: Margin/viewport updates can reapply only a nonnil target or still-owned initial request. After stop clears target, resize has no persistent programmatic ID reissue in this code; AppKit bounds/live-scroll observers may still schedule native snap.
strict_static_findings.unknown: Actual bounds notifications, ScrollViewProxy placement, chosen NSScrollView and native14 resize preservation must be observed before claiming wrong center or lost target.
